# SMS playbook — copy

Generated by `build.py` from `data/sms.json` and the flow files. Edit those, not this file. Character counts use sample token values and a 23-character short link.

## Consent disclosure

Use this under every web opt-in that says "full". Have counsel approve it before launch.

> By entering your phone number and submitting this form, you agree to receive recurring automated marketing text messages (such as offers, restock alerts and cart reminders) from Architectural Depot at the number provided. Consent is not a condition of any purchase. Msg frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help or STOP to cancel at any time. See our Privacy Policy and SMS Terms.

## Opt-in placements

### Signup popup, step 2

*Shown right after the email step submits, desktop and mobile. Phone field pre-set to +1.*

- **Headline:** Want first word by text?
- **Body:** Early access to sales, restock alerts on the pieces you're watching, and quick help with your order.
- **Button:** Text me · **Decline:** No thanks
- **Disclosure:** By entering your phone number and submitting this form, you agree to receive recurring automated marketing text messages (such as offers, restock alerts and cart reminders) from Architectural Depot at the number provided. Consent is not a condition of any purchase. Msg frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help or STOP to cancel at any time. See our Privacy Policy and SMS Terms.
- **Target:** 1 in 4 email signups also give a phone number

### Site footer form

*Separate phone field under the email field, each with its own submit.*

- **Headline:** Get texts from Architectural Depot
- **Body:** Sale early access and restock alerts.
- **Button:** Sign up for texts
- **Disclosure:** By entering your phone number and submitting this form, you agree to receive recurring automated marketing text messages (such as offers, restock alerts and cart reminders) from Architectural Depot at the number provided. Consent is not a condition of any purchase. Msg frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help or STOP to cancel at any time. See our Privacy Policy and SMS Terms.
- **Target:** Steady trickle; watch for spam submissions

### Checkout checkbox

*Next to the phone field in Miva checkout. Unchecked by default. Needs a checkout customization plus a call to Klaviyo's subscribe API; the standard integration does not pass SMS consent.*

- **Headline:** Text me offers and order help from Architectural Depot
- **Disclosure:** Recurring automated marketing texts. Consent not required to buy. Msg frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to cancel. SMS Terms and Privacy Policy.
- **Target:** Highest-volume source once live

### Order confirmation page

*Inline form below the order summary.*

- **Headline:** Questions on delivery day? Get help by text
- **Body:** Plus early access to sales and restock alerts.
- **Button:** Text me
- **Disclosure:** By entering your phone number and submitting this form, you agree to receive recurring automated marketing text messages (such as offers, restock alerts and cart reminders) from Architectural Depot at the number provided. Consent is not a condition of any purchase. Msg frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help or STOP to cancel at any time. See our Privacy Policy and SMS Terms.
- **Target:** Buyers are the most valuable subscribers

### Keyword: DEPOT

*Packing-slip insert, printed catalogs, CS email signatures, the phone hold message. Phone agents send callers the keyword instead of signing them up by voice.*

- **Headline:** Text DEPOT to [number] for sale early access and restock alerts.
- **Disclosure:** Msg frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to cancel. Terms: architecturaldepot.com/sms-terms
- **Target:** Turns offline buyers and catalog readers into subscribers

### Pro signup form

*Checkbox on the pro form, unchecked by default.*

- **Headline:** Text me pro updates and restock alerts
- **Disclosure:** By entering your phone number and submitting this form, you agree to receive recurring automated marketing text messages (such as offers, restock alerts and cart reminders) from Architectural Depot at the number provided. Consent is not a condition of any purchase. Msg frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help or STOP to cancel at any time. See our Privacy Policy and SMS Terms.
- **Target:** Small list, high value

## System replies

### SYS-DOI · Double opt-in request

*Sent by Klaviyo after a web form collects a phone number. The person replies Y to confirm.*

> Architectural Depot: Reply Y to confirm you want recurring automated marketing texts from us. Consent not required to buy. Msg & data rates may apply.

_150 chars · 1 segment(s) · GSM-7_

### SYS-JOIN · Keyword join reply (DEPOT)

*Reply to anyone who texts DEPOT. Their text is the opt-in, so this confirms it.*

> Architectural Depot: You're in for recurring automated marketing texts. Msg frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help, STOP to cancel.

_158 chars · 1 segment(s) · GSM-7_

### SYS-HELP · HELP reply

*Reply to HELP, INFO.*

> Architectural Depot: Call 1-888-573-3768 (M-F 8am-6pm, Sat 8am-12pm CT) or email cs@architecturaldepot.com. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to cancel.

_157 chars · 1 segment(s) · GSM-7_

### SYS-STOP · STOP reply

*Reply to STOP, END, CANCEL, UNSUBSCRIBE, QUIT, STOPALL. The only text sent after an opt-out.*

> Architectural Depot: You're unsubscribed and won't get more marketing texts from us. Reply START to rejoin.

_107 chars · 1 segment(s) · GSM-7_

### SYS-START · START / UNSTOP reply

*Reply to START, UNSTOP, YES from someone who opted out.*

> Architectural Depot: Welcome back to recurring automated marketing texts. Msg freq varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help, STOP to cancel.

_155 chars · 1 segment(s) · GSM-7_

### SYS-AUTO · Auto-reply to other messages

*Only if nobody staffs the SMS inbox. If CS answers texts, skip this and set a response-time target.*

> Architectural Depot: Thanks for your text. This number isn't monitored. For help, call 1-888-573-3768 or email cs@architecturaldepot.com. Reply STOP to opt out

_159 chars · 1 segment(s) · GSM-7_
